items.name: Melbourne's Crazy Clock Challenge 2020
items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. **Please note**: There is no 3x3x3 being held. **The main event of this competition is Clock.** This competition will immediately precede FMC World. If you pay for this competition you will get FMC World FREE! **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: Silent Sydney 2020
items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. **Please note: There is no 3x3x3 Cube at this competition. The main event of the competition is 3x3x3 Multi-blind.** This competition will take place immediately before FMC 2020 in the same room as the Sydney location. If you compete in this competition you are not required to pay the entry fee for FMC 2020 Sydney location. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)
